name: WF-01 — Product Add & Sync to All 7 Stores
description: Receives product via Telegram or webhook → Claude writes descriptions → syncs to all WooCommerce stores
steps: 1. Telegram Trigger → parse product name, price, category, image URL
2. Claude API → generate title, short desc, long desc, meta title, meta desc, tags
3. OpenAI Images → generate lifestyle product image if none provided
4. Loop: POST product to all 7 WooCommerce stores
6. Send Telegram confirmation with product URLs
